name: io.github.Poiuyhje/eqvps
title: EQVPS — Crypto VPS for AI agents
description: Crypto-paid, no-KYC VPS that AI agents rent and operate end-to-end over MCP: discover plans, register, top up with USDC/USDT, order a VPS, then control it (power, hostname, reinstall, metrics). Hosted commercial server; most tools need a Bearer token obtained via the register_account tool.
